headwords: tránh vỏ dưa gặp vỏ dừa
trâu bò húc nhau, ruồi muỗi chết

flags.why: The slang refers to a woman who feigns innocence while scheming, often interfering in another couple's relationship, and does not mean outspoken ([source](https://thanhnien.vn/lat-leo-chu-nghia-tieu-tam-va-tra-xanh-1851533019.htm)).
flags.fix: a woman who pretends to be innocent while scheming, especially to interfere in someone else's romantic relationship

flags.why: This slang is a derogatory label for a woman accused of manipulating others or interfering in their relationship ([source](https://thanhnien.vn/lat-leo-chu-nghia-tieu-tam-va-tra-xanh-1851533019.htm)).
The expression disparages someone for having a much younger partner, so the gloss's parenthetical warning also needs a derogatory tag.
